title: Peptlas open data - peptide regulatory status

datasets.title: Regulatory status by jurisdiction
datasets.description: One row per compound and authority: the current status under the U.S. FDA, Australia (TGA), the UK (MHRA), the EU (EMA), Health Canada and WADA, in a five-state taxonomy, with a plain-language note.

columns.name: compound
columns.description: Compound name as used on Peptlas.

columns.name: slug
columns.description: Stable identifier; joins the other files.

columns.name: regulator
columns.description: Short regulator name: FDA, TGA, MHRA, EMA, Health Canada, WADA.

columns.name: note
columns.description: What the status means for this compound under this authority.

columns.name: entry_url
columns.description: The Peptlas entry, with every primary source.

columns.name: last_verified
columns.description: Date (ET) the row was last verified by hand against primary sources.

datasets.title: Regulatory events log
datasets.description: Dated regulatory events for the tracked compounds (list removals, advisory votes, comment deadlines, enforcement), each with a neutral one-line summary and its primary source.

columns.name: tag
columns.description: not_legalized | status_change | review_scheduled | comment_deadline | enforcement | correction | clarification.

columns.name: summary
columns.description: What happened, and what it did not change.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: Primary or best-available source for the event.

datasets.title: FDA advisory committee votes
datasets.description: Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee votes on the tracked compounds. Advisory votes do not change legal status. Where the FDA has not published minutes, tallies are as reported and the reporting source is named.

columns.name: question
columns.description: The question put to the committee.

columns.name: tally_source
columns.description: Who reported the tally, while official minutes are unpublished.

columns.name: us_status_now
columns.description: The compound's current U.S. status - a vote alone never moves it.

datasets.title: Source bibliography
datasets.description: Every source cited by a Peptlas entry: regulator publications, dockets, warning letters and the reporting behind them, with what each one establishes.

columns.name: note
columns.description: What the source is cited for, where recorded.
